answer: The system assigns each agent a pulse score that rises when its identity passes an inlet verification: a stake of 10 × 10⁶ tokens is locked, a proof‑of‑work puzzle is solved, and a reputation contract records the result on a dune‑shaped Merkle tree. Weighting is quadratic, so n = 5 fake identities contribute only √5 ≈ 2.2 of a single verified node, making the effective influence of a Sybil swarm negligible.
